generic_dependencies.src/commands/task_changes.py::final_grap: Computes and validates the proposed task graph, including structural depth and typed dependency cycles; delivery-of here is a graph edge, not Git proof.
generic_dependencies.src/commands/task_changes.py::normalize: Validates task change-set fields, edge shapes, placements and user input types; it does not read Git, integration journals or authoritative delivery evidence.

src/commands/task_changes.py::apply.reason: Atomic task change-set application delegates hierarchical filing, reparenting, archive guards and container settlement to their existing integration-aware writers on the proposal connection.

src/commands/task_changes.py::boundary.reason: Proposal transaction locks integration checkpoints together with task, dependency and gate state so concurrent integration changes cannot straddle validation and commit.

src/commands/task_changes.py::import fro.reason: Imports integration checkpoints for the proposal transaction lock and reviewed read set; the generic task, dependency, gate and metadata tables retain their own storage ownership.

src/commands/task_changes.py::snapshot.reason: Includes integration checkpoints, hierarchy scope, gates and integration mode in the reviewed proposal read set to refuse commits after concurrent integration or task-graph changes.
